Select the three existing native-browser security contracts and an arm64 macOS compile check. The affected client journey requires a rebuilt Mac app and remains a manual release gate. Add reviewable diagnostic-expected comments only; select all seven temporary-chat contract tests to protect that existing lifecycle.

The affected Mac client is not remotely controllable, so live navigation, production Mac package, physical-device, and reconnect gates are unavailable for this PR; do not claim the operator workflow is complete from these checks. Local temporary-chat collection is blocked by the host Conda pyOpenSSL/botocore mismatch; CI Python 3.12 will collect and execute the seven tests. No temporary-chat runtime behavior changed.
